scope: The pinned v2 refinement of the fixed 15-case Source257 cohort only; independent final source/evidence review, not a new 172-profile inventory or class construction.
review_basis: Reviewed the original pinned Source257 RGB image through verified exact native crops and 90-degree clockwise views without rescaling, filtering, OCR, or other cards.

Initial source observations preceded reading A/B outcomes. Later coordinate feedback and independent bare-crop reviews corrected mistaken target binding. Final evidence is post-feedback adjudication, not initial blind consensus.

Independently inspected the four complete trajectory views and all 15 focus views; all 15 corrected B whole-target crops; all 45 old/A/initial-B coordinate panels; all 27 literal old-mark crops; all 15 A/B union target crops and FC127 disputed subcrop; all 31 distinct unresolved-reference crops, compared with complete context.

Read all 15 final decisions, eight feature dimensions per case, all 45 ink-path allocations across 27 distinct case/old-locator alternatives, 100 case/reference alias comparisons, old-target crosswalks, reader discrepancies, causal measurements, and all 114 v1-to-v2 prose corrections.

Source-exact image provenance establishes crop fidelity, not target identity or correctness of marker/label placement. The final decision additionally requires observed full-route continuation, legacy main descriptor, neighbor order, and specific same-instance alias checks.
operational_discharge_criteria: Every specifically alleged foreign path is followed through visible connected ink to the complete target or a complete neighboring construction; mixed rectangles allocate separate ink paths and leave paper unassigned.

Complete target exterior, enclosed regions, openings, stems, bars, branches/returns, terminals, and observable significant marks remain represented. No dimension was removed or declared irrelevant to obtain eligibility.
Native windows are search rectangles, not segmentation masks. Same-coordinate overlap alone never proves ownership, alias identity, or absence of a target feature.

A recovered whole route must uniquely match the old ID through descriptor, continuous old-envelope intersection, complete path and neighbor order. Finding a convenient nearby complete shape is insufficient.

Every intersecting member of the exact baseline 135 unresolved-reference set must be physically distinguished by source routes/ends; unresolved internal partition or historical mark role stays unresolved.

Visible disconnection/proximity does not establish historical or cipher ownership of a detached mark; observational physical allocation is separate from semantic, functional, or letter interpretation.

exclusion_cause_interpretation.interpretation: The 117 exclusions are decisions under inherited policy, reader gates, and reported feature uncertainties; they are not 117 demonstrated cases of lost image information. The tested 15 are resolved through explicit source-path allocation and coordinate/description correction. This does not imply that all other 102 are physically recoverable or physically impossible.
exclusion_cause_interpretation.schema_identifiability: A demanded direction, arch count, or single-body label can impose ambiguity not equivalent to missing pixels. An actual dark junction may leave multiple graphic topologies compatible with the raster; this must be demonstrated on the particular source path, not inferred from an UNKNOWN flag. No irreversible dark-junction information loss was established in this cohort.
exclusion_cause_interpretation.observational_vs_semantic: Whole visible path and feature-profile completeness are observational. Pen history, language, cipher function, letter value, and historical detached-mark owner are not recovered by this method.

causal_attribution.explanation: The final cited evidence union includes local connections plus whole identity/order and alias-reference context. It records which source regions were used, not the smallest sufficient window. Some decisive local continuity was already within old context; nominal boundary crossings have approximately 3–5 pixel precision. Wider context was used, but its counterfactual necessity or isolated causal gain is unestablished. The supported gain belongs to the joint display/reading/allocation procedure.
